drivers.explanation: The patient-services lead who championed the program left in September, and the replacement, Omar, is only just getting up to speed, so the relationship is not yet re-established.
Portal engagement is minimal at a single weekly user, with no growth over 90 days, so the brand team has little visibility into program value.
Portal usage is flat at one weekly user, which suggests limited day-to-day engagement with program data even though patient volume is stable.

tool_input.next_step: Meet with Omar this week to walk him through the program playbook and set up a joint review of portal use, with a plan to bring the brand team back into the portal.
